scope: Diagnostic raw native traces and call time only; no policy training, benchmark reward or training speedup claim.
schedule: after recurrent native worker21213860_0; before pending entropy worker21211006_0, preserving four serial chains

method.execution: Two environments, one independent spawned process per environment; synchronous step/reset barriers with replies in environment-index order.
method.actions: Uniform legal actions drawn in the parent from one private NumPy generator per environment; fixed BTA/PROF/version/seed namespace.
method.trace: Every raw observation, array dtype/shape, action, reward, episode flag, info and explicit reset; no time values in equality traces.
method.ordering: Normal trials alternate sequential/process then process/sequential then sequential/process. Fresh environments each trial; seeds unchanged.
method.timing: Native step plus subsequent reset call wall time includes IPC; startup, initial resets, close and trace I/O reported separately. No actor, normalization or PPO update.
method.memory: Inspect post-job Slurm sampled batch-step MaxRSS; it is not a guarantee for later learning workloads.

required_gates: Both condition reports complete, all declared trials present, full source/config/instrumentation provenance unchanged.
Exact sequential/process trace equality for every environment and repeat; every owned worker closes gracefully with exit0.
Normal condition6144 total environment decisions; frequent-restart condition2048; total8192; no replacement or hidden retries.
Frequent-restart condition observes at least one planned native restart in each environment in both modes.
Inspect per-trial timing ratios and sampled memory under2CPU/8GB before deciding whether to implement a training backend.
limits: These are raw scripted-action traces, not trained-policy rollouts or normalized training parity.
A future collector still needs exact normalizer-order, recurrent-carry, gradient/optimizer/checkpoint and evaluation parity.
A timeout, unplanned simulator failure, forced cleanup or trace mismatch invalidates the diagnostic and remains visible.
